data.name: Arsal
data.gender_notes: Arsal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Arsal means 'angel of God' or 'messenger of God'. This name is derived from the root word 'R-S-L' which means 'to send' or 'to dispatch'. The name Arsal carries the meaning “Angel of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arsal usually hope their child will grow to embody angel of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: According to Quranic texts, Arsal refers to the angels sent by God to guide and protect humans.
data.etymology: Arsal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Angel of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arsal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أرسل
in_arabic.long_meaning: أرسل هو اسم عربي يعني المبعوث أو المرسل، ويتعلق بالرسول أو المرسل الذي يرسله الله ليدعو الناس إلى دين الإسلام، وهو اسم شائع في الثقافة الإسلامية وله دلالة روحية كبيرة حيث يعبر عن الوجهة الإلهية والرسالة السماوية

in_urdu.name: ارسل
in_urdu.long_meaning: ارسل ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب بھیجا ہوا یا مرسل ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کے پیغام کو پہنچانے والے رسول کی 象徵 ہے، اور اس نام کی روحانی اہمیت بھی بہت زیادہ ہے

in_hindi.name: अर्सल
in_hindi.long_meaning: अर्सल एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ भेजा हुआ या संदेष्टा है, और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है क्योंकि यह भगवान के संदेश को पहुँचाने वाले रसूल का प्रतीक है, और इस नाम का आध्यात्मिक महत्व भी बहुत अधिक है

in_pashto.name: ارسل
in_pashto.long_meaning: ارسل د عربي نوم دی چې د ليږل شوي یا استاز په معنا دی، او دا نوم په افغان/پشتون کلتور کې ډېر مشهور دی ځکه چې دا د الله پيغام ته رسېدلو د رسول د نمائندګي کوي، او دا نوم د روحاني اهميت څخه هم ډک دی

in_english.name: Arsal

data.cultural_impact: The name Arsal holds a rich cultural significance in Islamic tradition. The name Arsal also highlights the critical role of messengers and angels in delivering God's message to humanity.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Arsal evokes a deep sense of reverence and awe towards the Almighty Allah, who sends His angels as His messengers to guide, protect, and watch over us. It encourages us to maintain a strong faith and deep trust in Allah's wisdom and mercy, knowing that His angels are always by our side to provide guidance and support throughout our lives.
